strings.zh: 欢迎来到战斗城堡！{SCROLL}在这里向您介绍单人玩的{NEWLINE}单人战和双打！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Castle!{SCROLL}I am your guide to the Single and{NEWLINE}Double Battle challenges.{SCROLL}Please be aware that these challenges{NEWLINE}are designed for a single Trainer.{SCROLL}
Which challenge would you{NEWLINE}like to take? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 在这个战斗城堡里{NEWLINE}灵活使用城堡点数,{CLEAR}看看能够撑到什么地步。{CLEAR}城堡点数⋯⋯{SCROLL}也就是ＣＰ会根据你的{NEWLINE}胜利方式和内容发生变化！{SCROLL}推荐用这些ＣＰ{NEWLINE}回复精灵的体力,{SCROLL}或者租借道具来进行战斗。{SCROLL}成功取得７连胜之后{NEWLINE}将获赠ＢＰ值！{SCROLL}另外,如果要临时中断挑战,{SCROLL}必须保存好进度,不然{NEWLINE}就不能从上次的{SCROLL}中断点接着玩了！{NEWLINE}一定要注意这一点！{SCROLL}
strings.en: At the Battle Castle, you make clever{NEWLINE}use of Castle Points and see how far{CLEAR}you can last.{SCROLL}Castle Points... that is, CP, change{NEWLINE}depending on how you win and how the{CLEAR}battle goes!{SCROLL}We recommend using CP to restore your{NEWLINE}Pokémon’s HP,{SCROLL}or to rent items for battle.{SCROLL}Win 7 battles in a row to earn BP!{SCROLL}Also, if you want to take a break from{NEWLINE}your challenge,{SCROLL}be sure to save, or you won’t be able{NEWLINE}to pick up where you left off!{SCROLL}Please keep that in mind!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0109/2 | RV043: addition: stale US rules text replaced with what the hack says

strings.zh: 欢迎来到战斗城堡！{SCROLL}这儿向您介绍可以和{NEWLINE}朋友一起玩的多人战！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Castle!{SCROLL}I am your guide to the Multi{NEWLINE}Battle challenge, which you can{CLEAR}take on with a friend!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0109/3 | RV043: meaning: zh 'can play with a friend', not 'requires two Trainers'

strings.zh: 要挑战战斗城堡多人战吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Would you like to take the Battle{NEWLINE}Castle Multi Battle challenge? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 这儿可以两个人合作{NEWLINE}与训练师进行多人战！{SCROLL}战胜了的话每人都能得到ＣＰ！{SCROLL}ＣＰ不但可以用于自己的精灵{NEWLINE}也可以用于朋友的精灵。{SCROLL}不断征战当成功实现{NEWLINE}７连胜之后,{CLEAR}会获赠ＢＰ值！{SCROLL}另外,在进行多人战的时候{NEWLINE}不能临时中断！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Here, two of you can team up for Multi{NEWLINE}Battles against Trainers!{SCROLL}Each of you earns CP when you win!{SCROLL}You can use CP not only on your own{NEWLINE}Pokémon, but also on your friend’s.{SCROLL}Keep battling, and if you win 7 in a row,{NEWLINE}you’ll earn BP!{SCROLL}Also, Multi Battles{NEWLINE}can’t be interrupted!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0109/5 | RV043: addition: stale US rules text replaced with what the hack says

strings.zh: 那么,恭候您的再次光临！

strings.zh: 竖起耳朵给我听好了！{NEWLINE}如果能让精灵无伤获胜,{CLEAR}那你将能得到{CLEAR}大量的城堡点数！{SCROLL}这东西是多多益善,{NEWLINE}你看大叔我{CLEAR}一个子儿都摸不出来,真丢人啊。
strings.en: Prick up your ears and listen good!{SCROLL}If your Pokémon win without taking{NEWLINE}any damage, you’ll earn a ton{CLEAR}of Castle Points!{SCROLL}The more of these, the better. Look at{NEWLINE}this old guy, can’t scrape together a{CLEAR}single point. How embarrassing.
strings.notes: US 0109/46 | RV043: omission: not a single point, 真丢人 and 大叔 self-reference (D-1655)

strings.zh: 如果你提升了对手的{NEWLINE}等级并取得胜利,{CLEAR}那你获得的{CLEAR}城堡点数也就是ＣＰ{CLEAR}将会有所增加。{SCROLL}这也就是{NEWLINE}所谓的{CLEAR}风险与机遇并存。
strings.en: If you raise your opponent’s level and{NEWLINE}still win, you’ll earn more Castle{CLEAR}Points, or CP.{SCROLL}That’s what they call{NEWLINE}high risk, high return.
strings.notes: US 0109/47 | RV043: meaning: raise the opponent's level and win (D-1655)

strings.zh: 在开战之前,{NEWLINE}你别吝啬自己的ＣＰ,{CLEAR}应该在这好好对对手调查一番！{SCROLL}俗话说的好,{SCROLL}不入虎穴{NEWLINE}焉得虎子{NEWLINE}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{SCROLL}呀,貌似不是这么用的！
strings.en: Before a battle, don’t be stingy with{NEWLINE}your CP. You should look into your{CLEAR}opponent thoroughly here!{SCROLL}As the old saying goes,{SCROLL}‘If you don’t enter the tiger’s den,{NEWLINE}how can you catch the tiger’s cub?’ ...{SCROLL}Huh, guess that’s not how you use it!
strings.notes: US 0109/48 | RV043: meaning: restored the tiger proverb and the speaker's self-correction

strings.zh: 石兰{SCROLL}能舍身为嘉德丽雅⋯⋯{CLEAR}这年头,{SCROLL}还能找到这么好的人吗？
strings.en: Darach, willing to sacrifice himself for{NEWLINE}Caitlin...{SCROLL}Where can you find a man that good{NEWLINE}these days?
strings.notes: 石兰 Darach / 嘉德丽雅 Caitlin. | RV043: softened: 舍身 is self-sacrifice (D-1656)

strings.zh: 刚开始的时候{NEWLINE}只能回复精灵的ＨＰ,{SCROLL}但随着ＣＰ的增加和{NEWLINE}等级的提升,{SCROLL}就算是ＰＰ{NEWLINE}也是可以回复的！
strings.en: At first, you can only restore your{NEWLINE}Pokémon’s HP,{SCROLL}but as your CP grows and your rank{NEWLINE}goes up,{SCROLL}you can even restore PP!
strings.notes: US 0109/50 | RV043: meaning: rank rises as CP grows; US 'spend CP to rank up'

strings.zh: 在这座城堡中,{NEWLINE}你要意识到因为一个失败{SCROLL}而让你辛苦积攒的ＣＰ{NEWLINE}付诸东流就和家常便饭一样。
strings.en: In this castle, you have to accept{SCROLL}that a single loss wiping out all the CP{NEWLINE}you worked so hard to save is an{CLEAR}everyday thing.
strings.notes: US 0109/51 | RV043: meaning: stale US rule text; zh says losing hard-earned CP to one loss is commonplace

strings.zh: 我将来的愿望就是{NEWLINE}穿上漂亮的礼服,{CLEAR}住在城堡中！{SCROLL}⋯⋯错了错了！{SCROLL}是和穿着漂亮的礼服的人{NEWLINE}共塌堡中！
strings.en: My dream is to wear a beautiful dress{NEWLINE}and live in a castle!{SCROLL}...No, no, wrong!{SCROLL}To share a bed in a castle with someone{NEWLINE}wearing a beautiful dress!
